description: We are HANOVA, a passionate two-member team driven by curiosity, creativity, and a love for innovation. Through the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we aim to transform NASA Earth observation data into practical, sustainable solutions for Sarawak's agriculture. With enthusiasm and a willingness to learn, we strive to turn bold ideas into meaningful real-world impact.
summary:
Farmers face increasing uncertainty from changing rainfall patterns, temperature fluctuations and declining soil health. Yet many lack accessible tools to interpret complex environmental data and evaluate crop rotations that balance climate suitability, soil conservation and economic practicality. Without clear, location-specific guidance, making informed and sustainable farming decisions remains challenging.

BUMI SHIFT bridges this gap by transforming NASA POWER environmental observations into accessible, personalized agricultural decision support.

Piloted in Sarawak, Malaysia, the platform analyzes historical rainfall and temperature data to screen 11 crops for climate compatibility. Beyond identifying suitable crops, it compares existing farming practices with alternative crop rotations, explaining potential soil-management benefits, environmental risks and trade-offs.

Through interactive maps, climate visualizations and a 3D farm planner, farmers can explore proposed changes and understand the evidence behind each strategy. Integrated Sarawak agricultural statistics and personalized market guidance further support practical decisions involving potential buyers, transportation and post-harvest handling.

BUMI SHIFT connects NASA Earth observations with real-world farming considerations, empowering farmers to explore more informed, soil-conscious and climate-resilient agricultural strategies while preserving their role in decision-making.
details:
BUMI SHIFT — Rethink Your Crops. Restore Your Soil

1. The Problem: Bridging the Gap Between Climate Data and Farming Decisions

Farmers increasingly face unpredictable rainfall, temperature fluctuations, water-management challenges and declining soil health. Yet many lack accessible tools to translate complex environmental data into practical crop-rotation decisions.

Choosing a climate-compatible crop is only the beginning. Farmers must also consider how alternative crops affect existing rotations, soil-management practices, water requirements and market opportunities. Without integrated, location-specific guidance, balancing environmental sustainability with economic practicality becomes increasingly challenging.

BUMI SHIFT bridges this gap by transforming NASA Earth observations into personalized, explainable and actionable farming strategies.

2. Our Solution: An Integrated Agricultural Decision-Support Platform

Developed by Team HANOVA for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, BUMI SHIFT is an interactive, web-based agricultural decision-support platform piloted in Sarawak, Malaysia.

Unlike conventional tools that focus primarily on climate monitoring or individual crop suitability, BUMI SHIFT connects environmental analysis, crop-rotation planning, interactive visualization and market preparedness within one accessible system.

The platform guides farmers through five interconnected features:

My Farm — Personalized Agricultural Assessment

Farmers enter their location, current crop, preferred crop, farming priority and field-drainage conditions.

These inputs establish a personalized assessment context, allowing farmers to explore agricultural alternatives relevant to their selected location and farming circumstances.

Explore Crops — Discover Climate-Compatible Opportunities

Using historical NASA POWER rainfall and temperature observations, BUMI SHIFT screens 11 crops for climate compatibility.

Farmers can explore ranked compatibility indices, candidate planting windows and crop-specific environmental evidence, helping them understand which crops appear compatible with their local climate.

Importantly, this feature focuses on exploring individual crop options, while actual cropping-strategy suggestions are provided through Plan My SHIFT.

Plan My SHIFT — Personalized Crop-Rotation Strategies and Interactive 3D Planning

Plan My SHIFT is the core agricultural decision-making feature of BUMI SHIFT.

Rather than simply suggesting an individual crop, the system compares existing farming practices with alternative cropping sequences based on climate compatibility, crop-family diversity and the farmer's selected preferences.

Each candidate strategy includes:

  • A proposed crop sequence and approximate cultivation duration.
  • Climate compatibility comparisons against the existing rotation.
  • Potential soil-management and crop-diversification benefits.
  • Supporting environmental evidence, practical considerations and trade-offs.

What makes this feature especially engaging is its interactive 3D Farming SHIFT Planner.

Farmers can switch between their current farm and a proposed cropping strategy, explore different rotation stages, adjust illustrative crop-development stages and visualize soil-cover management.

This transforms crop-rotation planning from a set of numerical comparisons into an interactive experience, making proposed farming changes easier to understand before implementation.

Growing Conditions — Turning NASA Data into Agricultural Insights

BUMI SHIFT transforms NASA POWER environmental observations into accessible visualizations of rainfall, temperature, humidity, solar irradiation, wind speed and atmospheric pressure.

Through interactive charts and environmental explanations, farmers can better understand seasonal growing conditions and the scientific evidence informing crop screening and rotation comparisons.

Market Insights — Connecting Sustainable Farming with Economic Practicality

Market Insights is one of BUMI SHIFT's strongest distinguishing features, extending crop-rotation planning beyond environmental compatibility into real-world agricultural decision-making.

A crop may appear suitable for local growing conditions, but introducing it into a farming system also requires consideration of market demand, potential buyers, post-harvest handling and transportation.

To address this, BUMI SHIFT integrates relevant Sarawak agricultural production and planted-area statistics, with their reporting years and geographic coverage identified.

The platform connects selected crops with potential agricultural products, selling channels and crop-specific handling requirements.

Its Personalized Market Strategy Advisor takes this further.

Farmers indicate whether they have identified a buyer, arranged transportation and prepared suitable handling or storage. Based on these responses and the selected crop, the system generates prioritized, crop-specific actions to support market preparation.

For example, a farmer considering sweet potato can explore relevant production statistics, potential fresh-produce or processing channels, root-quality considerations and practical arrangements to confirm before harvesting.

By connecting environmental compatibility with market preparedness, BUMI SHIFT helps farmers evaluate whether a proposed farming change is not only worth exploring agronomically, but also practical to pursue economically.

3. How It Works: NASA-Powered Agricultural Intelligence

NASA POWER (Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources) provides the environmental foundation of BUMI SHIFT.

When farmers select a location, the backend retrieves historical environmental observations and processes them into monthly and annual summaries.

The crop-screening engine compares historical rainfall and mean temperature with provisional crop requirements using a weighted compatibility model:

Climate Compatibility Index = 100 × (0.55 × Rainfall Compatibility + 0.45 × Temperature Compatibility)

These indices provide preliminary environmental screening rather than predicted crop yields.

The strategy engine subsequently compares candidate cropping sequences against existing practices, considering climate compatibility and crop-family diversity.

The system connects these results with farmer-provided information to present understandable explanations of why a rotation is worth exploring, what benefits it may offer and which practical considerations are relevant.

The 3D Farming SHIFT Planner visualizes the selected strategy, while Market Insights extends the process to crop-specific selling and logistical preparation.

This creates a connected decision-support workflow: NASA environmental evidence → crop compatibility → rotation strategies → interactive farm visualization → market preparation.

4. Creativity and Innovation: What Makes BUMI SHIFT Stand Out?

BUMI SHIFT's innovation lies in transforming multiple aspects of agricultural decision-making into a single, farmer-friendly experience.

1. Beyond conventional crop recommendations

BUMI SHIFT distinguishes individual crop compatibility from complete rotation planning, helping farmers evaluate alternative cropping sequences rather than simply identifying the highest-scoring crop.

2. Explainable and personalized farming strategies

The platform connects NASA environmental evidence with farmer priorities and cropping practices, providing transparent comparisons, supporting explanations and practical considerations.

3. Interactive 3D agricultural visualization

Instead of relying exclusively on tables and charts, BUMI SHIFT allows farmers to visualize proposed cropping sequences, illustrative growth stages and field-management changes through an interactive 3D environment.

4. Agricultural planning connected to market realities

One of the platform's most distinctive contributions is its integration of Sarawak agricultural statistics and personalized market guidance.

This connects environmental planning with potential selling opportunities, post-harvest preparation and logistical considerations, addressing a practical dimension that climate-only screening cannot resolve.

5. Accessible scientific information

Through interactive maps, real crop photographs, colour-coded comparisons and simplified environmental explanations, BUMI SHIFT makes complex scientific information more approachable to farmers without specialized geospatial expertise.

Together, these features position BUMI SHIFT as an integrated farming decision-support platform that connects scientific evidence, practical planning and farmer understanding.

5. Technology and Development

BUMI SHIFT was developed using a combination of environmental data services, software technologies and interactive visualization tools.

  • NASA POWER: Historical rainfall, temperature and supporting environmental observations.
  • Python and FastAPI: Backend processing, environmental-data retrieval, crop compatibility screening and rotation-strategy generation.
  • HTML, CSS and JavaScript: Responsive, farmer-friendly web interface.
  • Leaflet and OpenStreetMap: Interactive location selection and geographic visualization.
  • Chart.js: Environmental-data charts and rotation comparisons.
  • Three.js: Interactive 3D farm visualization and crop-stage exploration.
  • OpenDOSM and Sarawak agricultural resources: Regional production statistics and market context.
  • GitHub and Render: Source-code management and web application deployment.

Source Code(Github): hannahtoh07/BUMI-SHIFT-HANOVA: NASA-powered 3D agricultural decision-support prototype for Sarawak

Live Web Application: https://bumi-shift-hanova.onrender.com/app

6. Intended Impact: Making Climate-Informed Farming More Accessible

BUMI SHIFT aims to reduce the gap between environmental science and everyday agricultural decision-making.

Its potential impact extends across five areas.

Climate resilience: Helping farmers identify climate-compatible crop alternatives and understand environmental patterns relevant to cropping decisions.

Soil-conscious farming: Encouraging consideration of crop-family diversification, nutrient cycling and soil-cover management when exploring rotations.

Water management: Supporting awareness of rainfall variability, drainage considerations and crop-specific water requirements.

Economic preparedness: Helping farmers connect cropping decisions with potential selling channels, regional agricultural information and practical market arrangements.

Farmer empowerment: Making scientific evidence easier to interpret through interactive visualizations and explainable strategy comparisons, while preserving farmer judgment in the decision-making process.

Beginning with Sarawak as a pilot region, BUMI SHIFT provides a framework that could be adapted to other agricultural communities through relevant local datasets and crop information.

Our intended impact is not simply to help farmers grow different crops, but to help them make more informed decisions about adapting their farms while considering both environmental sustainability and economic practicality.

7. Key Considerations in Our Design

Throughout development, Team HANOVA prioritized scientific relevance, farmer accessibility, environmental sustainability and practical feasibility. We considered historical rainfall and temperature patterns, crop-specific requirements, existing cropping practices, crop-family diversity, potential soil-management benefits and field-drainage conditions. Recognizing that climate compatibility alone does not determine agricultural success, we also incorporated farmer priorities, regional agricultural statistics, potential selling channels and post-harvest requirements. These considerations shaped BUMI SHIFT into an explainable decision-support platform that connects environmental evidence with real-world farming decisions.


8. Conclusion

BUMI SHIFT transforms NASA Earth observations into an integrated agricultural decision-support experience that connects environmental understanding with practical farming action.

By combining climate compatibility screening, personalized crop-rotation comparisons, interactive 3D farm visualization and Sarawak-focused market guidance, the platform moves beyond conventional crop-selection tools.

It helps farmers explore not only what they could grow, but also how they could change their farming practices, why those changes may be worth considering and how to prepare for implementation.

Through this approach, Team HANOVA demonstrates the potential of NASA environmental data to support accessible, soil-conscious and climate-resilient agricultural planning.
